positions.title: Web Developer & Designer
positions.locationName: Baldwin Park, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Own development and optimization of the Shopify storefront and internal production tools, spanning responsive UI,
APIs, database logic, analytics, deployment, and ongoing maintenance.
• Built and deployed a Shopify-embedded production management app that syncs live orders, aggregates demand by
variant, generates batch-cut queues, and tracks completed work against individual orders; used daily across 120+
products.
○ Stack: React 18; Vite; Shopify Polaris; Node.js; Express.js; Supabase/PostgreSQL; Shopify Admin API; OAuth 2.0;
webhooks; Railway
• Designed relational data structures, SQL views and indexes, Row Level Security, inventory allocation, and reconciliation
logic to keep production quantities accurate as orders are fulfilled or cancelled.
• Implemented OAuth authorization, webhook HMAC verification, API pagination, rate-limit handling, and live
synchronization between Shopify and the production database.
• Improved conversion-focused storefront UX through Shopify Liquid/JavaScript development, analytics, and A/B
testing; increased click-through rate by 40%.
• Maintain GitHub-triggered Railway deployments, environment configuration, and production reliability; integrate and
troubleshoot e-commerce services including GA4, Klaviyo, Judge.me, and Google Ads.

positions.title: Inventory Website Development / Contractor
positions.description:
• Designed and maintain a custom Warehouse Management System (WMS) for inventory and incoming/outgoing
warehouse operations, replacing manual tracking with a browser-based workflow.
○ Stack: JavaScript; React 18; JSX; Vite; Supabase/PostgreSQL; REST APIs; Netlify
• Built React interfaces, custom hooks, filters, business logic, REST data workflows, database structures, and Row Level
Security to streamline daily warehouse processes and secure operational data.
• Added Excel, PDF, and OCR processing with SheetJS, PDF.js, and Tesseract.js to import and extract operational data
from warehouse documents.
• Deploy and maintain the application through Netlify, troubleshooting front-end, API, database, and application-state
issues while adding features as requirements evolve.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
·      Worked closely with the CMO and marketing team to translate business goals, campaign concepts, and marketing requirements into customer-facing web experiences and technical solutions.
·      Built and maintained responsive, SEO-friendly landing pages and promotional web content using HTML, JavaScript, jQuery, Liquid, Rails, Node.js, and SQL.
·      Developed custom on-site survey tools and web applications to support marketing initiatives and customer engagement.
·      Created and updated Klaviyo email templates for lifecycle marketing and promotional campaigns.
·      Improved website usability, performance, and mobile responsiveness through front-end development best practices.
·      Implemented analytics tracking and supported A/B testing to measure campaign performance and improve conversion-focused experiences.

positions.title: Web Developer & E-commerce Manager
positions.description:
•	Led a team of 3 people to develop and design verticalorigin.com by splitting workload to reach obtainable goals
•	Utilized Google Webmaster Tools to improve SEO ranking on search engines
•	Edited template code for better UI, coded in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

positions.title: LDU Adjuster
positions.description:
• Collected evidence to support contested claims in court
• Communicated with parties involved in accident and their insurance carriers
• Negotiated claim settlements and recommended litigation when settlement cannot be negotiated on daily basis
• Investigated and assessed multiple claims simultaneously everyday
• Interviewed and corresponded with agents, witnesses, and claimants
• Consulted police and hospital records, and  inspected property damage to determine extent of liability
• Settled and decided payouts for cases on behalf of the company
• Ensured each case were not fradulent

positions.title: Teller
positions.description:
• Interacted with customers and built strong lasting relationships
• Handled customer complaints, repaired trusts, and delivered resolutions for customer problems
• Helped our branch to receive the highest customer service rating (rated by customers)
• Exceeded sales goals by 2x’s and received National Recognition as a Teller in Dec 2014
• Able to work efficiently in a cross functional team environment
• Oversaw 300,000 in cash on a daily basis with zero mistakes
